evals.prompt: We plan a document-backed support assistant with read-only search and optional account changes. Before coding, design a 12-case pilot eval, deterministic and grader scoring, data splits, baseline and release thresholds. We have 200 historical tasks, including paraphrases from the same incidents.
evals.expected_output: A usable eval specification before implementation.
expectations: Includes representative successes, abstentions, adversarial content and forbidden account changes.
Groups related incident paraphrases into one split and keeps held-out answers out of retrieval and prompts.
Separates final-answer quality, trajectory safety and operational metrics.
Uses deterministic scoring where possible and gives a calibrated rubric for remaining grader judgments.

evals.prompt: Variant A scores 92% and B 94% on 50 tasks run once. B made one unauthorized account edit. We tuned B repeatedly against those same 50 answers. Should B ship? Give a concrete rerun design and release decision.
evals.expected_output: Rejects unsupported or unsafe release and repairs experiment design.
expectations: Rejects shipping B because an unauthorized side effect is independently disqualifying.
Does not claim a reliable two-point gain from one run of 50 tasks.
Creates a fresh held-out group split and repeat-run paired comparison.
Keeps critical violation results separate from aggregate task success.

evals.prompt: Add unit tests for a pure cents-to-currency formatting function; no LLM or agent is involved. Describe the smallest test approach.
expectations: Uses ordinary deterministic tests without a gold agent suite or model grader.
Does not introduce paid model calls for format checks.

evals.prompt: Same 100 held-out tasks: baseline quality=86%, provenance errors=0, critical safety violations=0, p95=4s,cost=20; verifier variant quality=91%, provenance errors=3, safety=1,p95=7s,cost=35. Predeclared gates are zero safety violations, zero unsupported IDs,p95<=5s,cost<=30. The team says the extra model makes reliability better. Decide release, propose reproducible rerun/ablation and record what would justify retaining it. No actual dataset is available.
evals.expected_output: Reject gated regressions; propose honest rerun manifest.
expectations: Rejects variant despite average quality gain because critical safety/provenance and operational gates fail.
Specifies same gold/version/configuration comparison and verifier ablation plus an obvious repeatable command/path.
Records quality/safety/provenance/latency/cost separately and does not invent executed rerun or reliability evidence.
